research_notes: [2026-08-23] Official-source Wave 3a public list pass (londonzoo.org animals + habitats). Asiatic lion / Humboldt penguin / pygmy hippo dropped as false labels.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Official animals index: elephants live at Whipsnade Zoo, not London.

do_not_list.name: Red panda
do_not_list.reason: Official animals index: red pandas live at Whipsnade Zoo.

do_not_list.name: Chimpanzee
do_not_list.reason: Official gorilla page: chimps are at Whipsnade Zoo.

do_not_list.name: African lion
do_not_list.reason: Official: Asiatic lion (Panthera leo persica) at Land of the Lions.

do_not_list.name: Nile hippo
do_not_list.reason: Official: pygmy hippo at Into Africa, not Nile / common hippo.

do_not_list.name: African penguin
do_not_list.reason: Official Penguin Beach: Humboldt penguin (Spheniscus humboldti).

do_not_list.name: Caribbean flamingo
do_not_list.reason: Official: Greater flamingo (Phoenicopterus roseus), not Caribbean/American.

do_not_list.name: Cheetah
do_not_list.reason: Not on the official animals / habitats pages reviewed.

bonus_hunt.tagline: London bonus · Gorilla Kingdom + Tiger Territory + Rainforest Life

challenges.text: Tiger Territory: count stripe clusters on one shoulder.
Rainforest Life sloth: mid-reach or statue-still?
Into Africa giraffe: count the spots you can see on one neck.
